## 2. Authorized Brand Ecosystem & OEM Hardware
Sunrise Communication is an authorized sales, installation, and maintenance partner for:
1. **CP Plus (Aditya Infotech) & Dahua:** IP Cameras, ColorVu, Analog HD Cameras, 4K NVRs, DVRs, PoE Switches, Mobile Surveillance.
2. **Hikvision India (Prama Hikvision):** ColorVu, AcuSense AI, DarkFighter IP Cameras, DeepInMind NVRs, ANPR Cameras.
3. **Matrix Comsec:** ETERNITY Hybrid IP-PBX, SPARSH IP Phones, COSEC Biometric Time-Attendance & Door Controllers.
4. **EPABX & Intercom Partners:** Syntel, Beetel, Crystal, Skylink, Matrix Telecom.
5. **Essl Security (eSSL):** Fingerprint Readers (X990, K90, SilkBio), Face Recognition Terminals (MultiBio 700, FaceStation), EM Locks.
6. **Structured Cabling & Networking:** Finolex, D-Link, Schneider Electric / Digilink, Polycab, CommScope (Cat6/Cat6A UTP/STP, Multi-Pair Armoured Copper, Server Racks).

## 3. Technical Service Verticals & Detailed Scope

### A. CCTV Surveillance Systems & Video Analytics
- **Supported Architecture:** 
  - Pure IP Network CCTV (1080p, 4MP, 5MP, 6MP Panoramic, 8MP 4K Ultra HD) over Cat6/Fiber PoE network.
  - Analog HD Surveillance (HD-CVI / HD-TVI / AHD) with RG59/Cat6 balun transmission for budget residential installations.
- **Key Capabilities:**
  - Full-color 24/7 Night Vision with Smart Warm White LED & Infrared (IR up to 80 meters).
  - H.265+ / Ultra H.265 Smart Video Compression reducing HDD storage consumption by up to 75%.
  - AI Video Analytics: Human & Vehicle Detection, Line Crossing, Intrusion Detection, Missing Object Alert, License Plate Recognition (ANPR).
  - Remote Smartphone / Desktop Live Streaming (gCMOB, Hik-Connect, iVMS-4200, Web GUI) with zero router port forwarding via Secure P2P Cloud.
- **Society Surveillance Packages:**
  - 4-Camera, 8-Camera, 16-Camera, 32-Camera, and 64-Camera turnkey installations covering Main Gates, Lobbies, Lift Cabins, Compound Perimeters, Parking Basements, and Terrace Access.

### B. EPABX & Housing Society Intercom Systems
- **Supported Architectures:**
  - Residential Society Multi-Pair Copper Intercom (Armoured 10/20/50/100-pair jelly-filled underground cables).
  - Modern Pure IP-PBX over structured LAN/Wi-Fi for luxury towers and corporate campuses.
  - Hybrid EPABX supporting Analog extensions, Digital operator consoles, and SIP Trunk VoIP connections.
- **Key Features:**
  - Flat-to-Security, Flat-to-Flat (with privacy restrictions), Flat-to-Society Office direct dialling.
  - Security Guard Gatekeeper Phone with Caller ID display.
  - Multi-Wing Intercom Linking across distinct building wings via Optical Fiber backbone.
  - Auto-Attendant (IVR), Call Recording, Music on Hold, Call Forwarding, Direct Inward Dialing (DID).

### C. Security System Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
- **Contract Models:**
  - **Comprehensive AMC:** Covers regular scheduled preventive maintenance visits plus repair/replacement of covered faulty electronic components as specified in the signed service agreement.
  - **Non-Comprehensive AMC:** Covers regular scheduled preventive maintenance visits, camera lens cleaning, voltage calibration, and unlimited emergency breakdown labor visits. Replacement spare parts and cable repairs billed separately at approved rates.
- **Routine Scope:**
  - Quarterly lens cleaning and refocusing.
  - Power supply unit (SMPS) voltage stabilization checks.
  - NVR/DVR hard drive health diagnostics, continuous recording audit, and timestamp synchronization.
  - Krone distribution box terminal crimping and intercom noise filtering.
  - Emergency breakdown attendance within 24 to 48 hours across Thane and Mumbai MMR.
- **Legal Boundaries & Standard Exclusions:**
  - Excludes damage caused by fire, lightning surges, flood/water ingress, rodent/pest cuts, civil work damage, and unauthorized third-party tampering.

### D. Biometric Attendance & Electronic Access Control
- **Authentication Technologies:** Optical Fingerprint (SilkID 360° sensor), 3D AI Facial Recognition (anti-spoofing dual camera), RFID Proximity / Mifare 13.56MHz Smart Cards, PIN Code.
- **Lock Hardware:** 600lbs / 1200lbs Fail-Safe Electromagnetic (EM) Door Locks, Drop Bolt Locks for frameless glass doors, Emergency Break-Glass Units, Battery Backup UPS.
- **Software Integration:** Desktop & Cloud Time-Attendance software, automated shift management, overtime calculation, CSV/Excel export, and automated payroll API sync.

### E. Structured Cabling & Physical Infrastructure
- Certified 100% Solid Copper Cat6 / Cat6A UTP/STP Cabling (Finolex / D-Link).
- 4U / 6U / 9U / 12U / 24U / 42U Wall-Mount and Floor-Standing Server Racks with cable managers and patch panels.
- ISI PVC Heavy-Duty Conduits with saddle clamping every 1 meter for maximum rodent and weather resistance.
- Underground armoured telephone multi-pair cable laying and Krone DP box moisture sealing.
